title: Why Water Feels Ice Cold After a Mint
caption:
Ever chugged water after a mint and felt FROZEN?
One cartoon guy pops a mint candy, takes a sip of water, and his mouth instantly becomes an ice cave - icicles, shivers and all.
Menthol hijacks your TRPM8 cold receptors, so plain water feels ice-cold - a chemical illusion, not real temperature.
Have you ever fallen for the mint-then-water trap?
Save this one for the next time it hits you.
